name: Landscape illustration
description:
使用建议：

1.建议分辨率在1024以上效果较优；

2.权重0.7~0.9之间，本人用0.7较多；

3.采样可用：DPM++2M Karras,Euler a,DPM++SDE,DPM++2S Karras；其余也可尝试；

4.采样步数建议：25,30,40；本人用30较多；

5.推荐搭配 arthemyComics 大模型使用效果最佳，其余使用动漫底模出图；

6.vae: 840000-ema-pruned | clip:2；

7.触发词：aqichahua,aqichahua,illustration,flat color,

8.关键词：

正面关键词 例如：tree,no humans,cloud,red,sky,outdoors,house,day,smile,blue sky,aqua background:1.1,Rich colors,white clouds,aqichahua,Flat style,ocean,(Masterpiece),(best quality), qichahua,illustration,flat color,<lora:Landscape illustration:0.7>,

负面关键词：bad_pictures,EasyNegative,bad_prompt_version2-neg,

（备注：这组负面关键词为embedding）

Usage suggestions:

1. It is recommended to have a resolution of 1024 or higher for better results;

2. The weight ranges from 0.7 to 0.9, and I use 0.7 more;

3. Sampling available: DPM++2M Karras, Euler a, DPM++SDE, DPM++2S Karras; Others can also be tried;

4. Suggested sampling steps: 25,30,40; I use more than 30;

5. It is recommended to use it with the arthemyComics large model for the best effect, and use the anime base model for the rest of the graphics;

6. vae: 840000 ema run | clip: 2;

7. Trigger words: aqichahua, aqichahua, illustration, flat color,

8. Keywords:

Positive keywords such as: tree, no humans, cloud, red, sky, doors, house, day, small, blue sky, aqua background: 1.1, Rich colors, white clouds, aqichahua, Flat style, ocean, (Masterpiece), (best quality), qichahua, illustration, flat color,<Lora: Landscape illustration: 0.7>,

Negative keyword: bad_ Pictures, EasyNegative, bad_ Prompt_ Version2 neg,

(Note: This group of negative keywords is embedding)

name: Landscape Anime Max (SDXL)
description:
Welcome to Landscape Anime Max SDXL!

LATEST VERSION: 1.1 ESTELLA+

FUTURE SUB-VERSIONS WILL COME OUT AS LoRAs INSTEAD OF CHECKPOINTS. Eg. 1.0 2.0 3.0 Checkpoints and 1.1 1.2 are LoRAs that could be used upon the version checkpoint!

This model is a derivative of the original "Landscape Anime Pro," enhanced with features from several other models, including animeIllustDiffusion v0.8 and YamersRealistic v5 and our new model's distillation outputs: EstellaXL.

Try to use the sampling method of DPM2++ a Karras or Heun at 20~50 steps for best outcomes. Clip Skip 2.

To stay updated and join our community, feel free to join our Discord server by the United DeviantArt AIGC Art Alliance: [https://discord.gg/2PfHqzxVAv](https://discord.gg/2PfHqzxVAv). Get the latest updates, or if you’d like to hear me chat in the admin channel (which is muted, but not locked 😉), come say hi!

Please note:

Landscape Anime Max SDXL is designed for image generation starting from 768x768 resolution up to 1536x1536. If you're looking to generate images at 512x512 or below, please check out the non-SDXL version of the model, Landscape Anime Pro, which is still being updated.

DISCLAIMER:

The early versions of this model may produce unstable outputs, and the quality can vary. For a more stable experience, please use Landscape Anime Pro.

name: Landscape poetry -- ancient style series illustrations
description:
Model creativity - a style model with an archaic bias towards comic books, focusing on generating archaic buildings and scenes; Reflecting the original beauty of ancient style illustration, compared with traditional Chinese painting, the color is brighter and the form is more straightforward; The brush touch and landscape brushwork of traditional Chinese painting are retained, while the figures are more inclined to modern aesthetics.

Model use - The output picture has a good pen and ink texture and traditional Chinese painting charm, the picture can be used for brand packaging design, operation poster design, daily commercial illustration.

Generate suggestions - This lora recommendation with 0.35 weight of the picture book lora use effect will be better; The weight is generally between 0.8-1, and the greater the weight, the closer the Q print style. Generation of character keywords can be added adult, children, Meng Meng, etc to control the age of the character. In addition to characters, it can also generate some elements such as animals and plants. The bottom film is recommended to use orangemix or CGArt Firefly;

Size :512*768 or 512*512 (enable high resolution repair), recommended sampling method: DDIM

Settings: Sampling: 25 steps, weight :0.8-1, DDIM, CLIP: 2

Trigger word: gufeng
